verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents a first-party AI surface through Dash. Dash is described as giving "clear answers" from shared team knowledge (dropbox-docs-11, dropbox-docs-44). Dash resource pages also cover summarizing files and PDFs, getting AI answers from files, and reviewing documents with AI (dropbox-docs-33, -34, -36, -37). However, the main Dropbox site still says "AI is coming to Dropbox" for summarization and organization (dropbox-docs-49), which suggests the storage product's own AI is announced rather than clearly shipped. The evidence is also mostly marketing and how-to content rather than product documentation. missing for 10: confirmation that AI is shipped inside core Dropbox storage rather than only in Dash, evidence of structured extraction, in-depth product docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
